strings.auth_mismatch: The Amazon account could not be verified. Say repair cloud authentication to check setup.
strings.auth_sign_in: Amazon sign-in needs attention. Try renew cloud authentication, or repair cloud authentication if it still fails.
strings.auth_stale: Authentication needs renewal. I will try again on your next request.
strings.setup_ready: Cloud storage is ready. Complete the one-time setup with your setup tool.
strings.status_expired: Your last request expired before speech was sent.
strings.status_dispatch_unconfirmed: I could not confirm that {agent} received your request. I am still waiting for a reply.
strings.status_retrying: Your answer is waiting after a temporary delivery problem. Amazon may retry while the request is valid.
strings.status_waiting: I am still waiting for your answer.
strings.outcome_target_unavailable: The linked Echo could not be found. Say link this Echo to check the link.
strings.outcome_auth_required: Your last answer was not sent because Amazon rejected authentication.
strings.outcome_dispatch_failed: Your last request was not sent to {agent}. Please try again.
strings.outcome_delivery_failed: Your answer could not be sent to the Echo. Please ask again.
strings.outcome_unconfirmed: I could not confirm your last speech delivery. I will not repeat it automatically.
strings.outcome_sending: Your last speech delivery is unconfirmed. I will not repeat it automatically.
strings.outcome_accepted_by_amazon: Amazon accepted your last answer for speech. I cannot verify that it was heard.
strings.status_nothing_waiting: No answer is waiting for delivery.
strings.status_renew_next: Setup is saved. Authentication will be renewed on your next request.
strings.status_ok: Setup is saved. No authentication failure is recorded.
strings.error_unconfirmed_speech: I could not confirm speech delivery. I will not repeat it automatically.
strings.error_busy: I am busy finishing another request. Please try again in a moment.
strings.error_temporary: There was a temporary connection or renewal problem. Please try again in a moment.
strings.error_needs_attention: {name} needs attention. Please try again later.
strings.open_to_set_up: Open {name} to finish setting it up.
strings.launch: What would you like to ask?
strings.no_device: I could not identify the requesting device.
strings.untimed: That request could not be timed safely. Please repeat it.
strings.test_duplicate: That test has already been submitted.
strings.test_sentence: This is {name} speaking directly from the hosted service. This is the end of the cloud connection test.
strings.test_sent: The cloud test was sent to {device}.
strings.which_echo: Which Echo is this? Say its name, or say cancel.
strings.which_echo_held: Which Echo is this? Say its name, or say cancel. I'll send your request once it's linked.
strings.link_start: Say link this Echo to start linking it.
strings.say_echo_name: Please say the Echo name, or say cancel.
strings.link_expired: Linking expired or was cancelled. Say link this Echo to start again.
strings.linked: This Echo is linked. Please ask your question.
strings.need_carrier: Please start your request with please or tell me.
strings.routine_missing: The cloud speech test is ready. The routine for {agent} still needs configuration.
strings.submit_untimed: That request could not be timed safely. Please ask again.
strings.submit_expired: That request has expired. Please ask again.
strings.not_sent_repair: Your request was not sent. Repair cloud authentication first.
strings.duplicate: That request was already received. You can ask for its status.
strings.changed: Your request was not sent because an earlier request or the Echo link changed. Please ask again.
strings.dispatch_failed: Your request was not sent to {agent}. Please try again.
strings.dispatch_unconfirmed: I could not confirm the request was sent. You can ask me to check cloud status.
